queer_characters.name: Eddy Martinez
queer_characters.notes: Butch widow of Vida (a woman) and co-owner of the bar; presented as a queer Latina elder figure. Source uses 'queer' rather than a more specific label.

queer_creators.name: Tanya Saracho
queer_creators.notes: Publicly self-identifies as queer; stated 'the queerness came from me. I identify as queer, and it had to be there.' Also served as creator and assembled an all-Latino writers' room prioritizing LGBTQ+ representation.
